# NimTube

> Pure Client-Side YouTube Studio & Downloader. Download YouTube videos and audio at full quality (4K, 1080p, M4A) directly in your browser with Mediabunny & WebCodecs. Zero server bandwidth, 100% your IP.

## Features

- [Video Downloader](https://nimtube.tr/): Download videos up to 4K 60fps directly on the client-side.
- [Audio Extractor](https://nimtube.tr/): Extract and save audio to M4A (AAC) or WebM (Opus) locally.
- [NimTube Bridge](https://nimtube.tr/?view=extension): Companion Chrome extension to download directly using your own IP address without server limits.

## Technology

- [Technical Architecture](https://nimtube.tr/?view=how-it-works): In-depth breakdown of Innertube API, streaming remux, and client-side streaming.
- [Mediabunny Core](https://nimtube.tr/?view=how-it-works): High-performance client-side lossless media multiplexing with 64-bit Mediabunny & WebCodecs GPU.
